content.title: Dana White admits the UFC White House event could be derailed at the last minute despite preparations
content.text: The UFC White House card was never going to be an easy event to pull off.Getting fights at the White House sanctioned as professional bouts is just one of the hoops that the leading MMA promotion has had to jump through ahead of June 14.The card itself doesn’t appear to have been a straightforward process, with Colby Covington recently claiming that the budget wasn’t high enough.There is one other issue that all kinds of events have to try and prepare for that will be completely out of the UFC’s hands come fight night.LATEST NEWS: Ilia Topuria set to star in HBO TV series ahead of Justin Gaethje clash at the White House Is this card White House worthy? 🤔 Rate it out of 10 in the comments ⬇️ UFC White House line up. Credit: UFC/X etravelstead12Featured commentRip can'tgetrightMMAharvey.leonardFeatured commentI can't quite believe how bad the cards have been. Just so hard to get invested in them. Really worrying that we're seeing a big decline instantly in this Paramount era, where they don't need to sell anything to the fans for PPV buysthisisjustatribute11Featured commentIt'll will be the second "decent" card of the year - 50% through the year. I knew that Paramount offer was too good to be true lol. I've never seen so many worthless cards as what they've vomited out in 2026. Dana White admits that they’d have to put the White House card on pause if there’s lightning Dana White unveiled images of what the UFC White House event will look like back in September, though there’s still a lot we don’t know.The promotion’s president recently stated during an appearance on Adin Ross’ Kick stream that he will be revealing the full layout, including the cage and walkouts, during this weekend’s UFC 327 event in Miami.With those images showing that there won’t be a roof over the event, White was asked during the stream about what they’ll do if it rains.“We’re fighting,” he responded. “If it f—— snows, we’re fighting. We’re fighting.”However, White did add that while they’re set on persevering through whatever the weather throws at them, there is one thing that could stop the show.“Lightning. Lightning is the only thing and what we’d have to do is just wait it out. We’d have to wait the lightning out and then do the fight.”LATEST NEWS: Dana White signs two of Eddie Hearn’s former stars in continuation of Conor Benn fallout What’s the one fight you’d add to the UFC White House card?
